meta_description: Prominence on 30A – Out of Office by Panhandle Getaways is a pet-friendly vacation home in Watersound, FL, featuring a peaceful location near the pool, a 6-seater golf cart, and easy access to The Big Chill’s restaurants, shops, and live entertainment.
description_expanded: Description Description Prominence on 30A – Out of Office by Panhandle Getaways is a pet-friendly vacation home in Watersound, FL, featuring a peaceful location near the pool, a 6-seater golf cart, and easy access to The Big Chill’s restaurants, shops, and live entertainment. Traveling with a pet? Upon arrival, your pup will receive a Posh Pet Gift Pack filled with fun, beach-ready goodies. Each pack also includes a Posh Pet Photo Contest card with a QR code for easy uploads - simply share a photo of your furry friend enjoying their new gear and bandana. If your pet is featured on our website or social channels, you’ll receive special swag or exclusive discounts. Sunshine, sand, and tail-wagging adventures await! LEARN MORE ABOUT THE PROMINENCE ON 30A NEIGHBORHOOD Welcome to Out of Office, a beautifully decorated 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom pet-friendly vacation home in Watersound, Florida by Panhandle Getaways. Perfect for families or small groups, this coastal retreat features a bright open living area with a 55" TV and Sonos sound system, a fully equipped kitchen with premium appliances, and inviting bedrooms designed for comfort. Enjoy cozy nights in with board games, books, and Blu-ray/DVD players, or explore 30A with four bikes and a 6-seater golf cart included with your stay. TOWNHOME FEATURES• 2-bedroom townhome on 30A• Pet Friendly• 6-seater LSV golf cart with 500-watt sound bar• Spacious living area with 55" TV, Blu-ray player, and Sonos sound system• Fully equipped kitchen with breakfast bar• Kitchen includes Cuisinart coffee maker, Keurig, Crockpot, and full cooking essentials• Dining area with seating for the whole family• Bedroom 1: King bed, 50" TV, Sonos, en suite bathroom• Bedroom 2: Queen bed and twin bed, 42" TV, Blu-ray player, Sonos• Bathroom 2: Tub/shower combo• Sonos wireless speakers in living room and both bedrooms• One-car garage• Garage includes a game area with TV, Atari games, oversized Connect 4, velcro dart board, and hook-and-ring game• 4 adult bikes and 2 kids’ bikes• Beach cart, four Tommy Bahama chairs, Sunbrella umbrella, and rolling cooler• Pet crate and food bowls provided for guest use• Complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi and Google Home hub with Google Assistant• Full-size washer and dryer• Quiet location near resort pool• Sleeps up to 5 guests ABOUT PROMINENCE ON 30A - WATERSOUND, FLProminence on 30A is one of the most popular communities along Scenic Highway 30A, offering incredible amenities, open green spaces, and easy access to over 17 miles of bike paths. Perfectly located near 30A favorites and the area’s sugar-white beaches, Prominence features a charming town center and two resort-style pools. At the heart of it all, The Big Chill is a lively gathering place featuring an outdoor 25-foot LED theater screen for concerts, movie nights, and sporting events, as well as boutique shops, family-friendly activities, and excellent dining options. Centrally situated between Seagrove and Seaside to the west and Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach to the east, Prominence places you right in the middle of everything that makes 30A special. COMMUNITY & THE BIG CHILL AMENITIES• Two resort-style zero-entry pools – perfect for all ages• Walking distance to The Big Chill – dining, shops, and nightly entertainment• Luke Bryan’s cigar and gastro pub – a favorite local hangout• Family movie nights and live sports on the outdoor big screen• Onsite ice machine and barbecue grilling areas• Close to Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Seaside• 3.5 miles to the nearest grocery store 30A PUBLIC BEACH ACCESS POINTSBeach access for all Prominence homes is available through South Walton public beach access points. Most guests use Deer Lake State Park or other nearby public accesses along 30A. Please note that Prominence homes do not have direct beach access through Watersound Club and do not include access to Watersound private club facilities. FREE DAILY ACTIVITIES INCLUDEDGuests enjoy FREE daily activities through our Xplorie partnership:• 1 FREE round of golf each day at 1 of 4 nearby courses (year-round)• 4 bikes ready to ride (year-round)• 1 FREE dolphin cruise or snorkel trip per day (March–October) PET FRIENDLYWe welcome well-behaved dogs under 40 lbs (maximum of 2, with approval). Pets must be disclosed at the time of booking. A non-refundable pet fee applies. Undisclosed pets are grounds for eviction and additional cleaning fees of up to $500. Dogs only. NOTICE• Complimentary use of the owner’s bikes, beach gear, games, and pet items is included; however, should any item be broken, lost, or similar, there will be no refund or compensation.• The community’s pool heating schedule is determined by the HOA and is subject to change at any time. Panhandle Getaways is not responsible for any changes to pool heating or availability. ADDITIONAL INFORMATIONA starter pack of toiletries, paper products, and detergents is provided for your arrival. Guests should plan to purchase additional supplies for the remainder of their stay. Bed linens and bath towels are included; please bring beach towels for pool and beach use. WHY WE LOVE ITOut of Office is the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and coastal charm. Spend your mornings cruising the neighborhood in your golf cart, your afternoons at the pool or beach, and your evenings relaxing with family in this beautifully equipped, pet-friendly home. Whether you’re unwinding indoors or exploring The Big Chill, this vacation spot captures the laid-back spirit of life on 30A. Read less
